reports.title: Laura Hill
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: We have instigated an escalation process whereby, if any equipment cannot be located within the mmediate ward environment, staff must contact the senior nurses on 'professional cover' for the Business 3roups by bleep in the first instance to assist in locating the equipment. Should the bleep-holder be unable '0 resolve the problem, this is to be escalated to the hospital site manager who will either locate the squipment or assist in the re-assessment of those currently in use across the hospital
promises.summary: Escalation process for equipment location and re-assessment

concerns.quote: Despite training being in existence in relation to the carrying out of Falls Risk Assessments there was a missed opportunity throughout the time Mrs Hill was in hospital for this to be carried out. There was no assessment on her admission to Ward C3 nor when she was transferred to Ward B6.

concerns.quote: if, from the falls risk assessment, there were concerns as to Mrs [name redacted] mobilising in and out bed and/or in and out of her chair and her stability then these would have been highlighted in the nursing notes/care plan and discussed at any handover

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that a falls risk assessment was not completed, leaving staff unaware of the patient's risk. This omission prevented proper communication and planning for fall prevention.
